requests.reply: {"t": [{"id":0, "text": "A rainy port town. A police car is parked in front of an old clock shop."}, {"id":1, "text": "Kaoru-senpai, the scene is here. The door was still locked"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Hmm. Only a pocket watch was stolen?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The owner, the elderly Takanashi, is staring at the floor while sitting in a chair."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You've come, detectives. Let me tell you beforehand, don't touch anything on your own."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Yes, Inspector. We'll be careful."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Stop calling me Inspector. Akira is fine. Especially in front of Takanashi-san."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Understood, Akira-san"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Old Takanashi slowly raised his face."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Akira folded his umbrella and wiped the drops from the floor."}, {"id":1, "text": "Akira-san, please leave your umbrella here"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Hikaru, who did you ask to watch the office?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "It's Nagi. I'm still a girl of eighteen, but I'm reliable. Akira, please don't worry."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "That's a relief. She can handle taking calls and organizing documents."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "We'll chat later. First, let's start the interrogation."}, {"id":1, "text": "Akira-san, how about we hear from Takanashi-san first?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The old man replied in a trembling voice that he closed the shop at nine last night."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "My grandfather has been polishing that clock for years"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Yuki hasn't been able to sleep since last night. Her fingertips have been trembling constantly."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Hikaru, what do you make of these footprints?"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Akira-san, these aren't the culprit's. The shoes are too big."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Hikaru's observational skills are reliable. He's still a rookie, but he's unmatched."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Kaoru removed her glasses and slowly pressed her fingertips to the bridge of her nose."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "That watch is also my mother's keepsake."}, {"id":1, "text": "Nagi rushed in, holding a wet umbrella."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Gasping for breath, he relayed the phone message."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Akira-san, the forensics results are out. I'll share them with the senior staff right away."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Let me hear it. ...Oh. The culprit is inside the store."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "Old Takanashi's hand trembled slightly."}, {"id":1, "text": "Outside the window, the rain grew particularly heavy."}]}
